title: Show HN: Trust – Coding Rust like it's 1989
summary: A Rust project that recreates the nostalgic coding style of 1989, embracing retro programming aesthetics and vintage computing era conventions in modern Rust development.
problem_solved: Brings back the nostalgic charm and simplicity of late 1980s coding conventions to modern Rust development for fun and educational purposes.
why_valuable: Offers a unique blend of retro computing nostalgia with modern Rust safety features, appealing to developers who appreciate vintage programming aesthetics.
